title: BRIDGE Pipeline Configuration
description: Schema for pipeline/config.json. Validated at Phase 0 Step 0.4. additionalProperties allowed for project-specific extensions.

security_gate.description: Security gate mode. blocking = critical findings prevent delivery

per_slice_review.description: Independent two-gate review (spec-compliance + code-quality) by a fresh agent after each build slice. risk-gated = only slices the Architect flagged Risk: high. See 04-build.md Step 4.3.5.

real_data_verification.description: For data-touching slices, the VERIFY step must include a dry run against a sample of real input data, not only fixtures. If no sample exists, the slice is recorded UNVERIFIED-ON-REAL-DATA. See 04-build.md Step 4.3.6.

advanced_orchestration.description: Dynamic Workflows + adversarial debate integration. ON by default but auto-gated by modules/capability-detection.md: effective state = enabled AND detected-available. If a feature is missing or removed from the running Claude Code, BRIDGE auto-falls back to the classic path on the next run. Distinct from the 'workflow' object above, which toggles in-pipeline review steps.

auto_detect.description: Run capability detection in Phase 0 and write pipeline/capabilities.json. If false, all advanced paths are treated as unavailable (classic pipeline only).

workflows.description: Delegate self-contained, high-fan-out sub-tasks to Dynamic Workflows (the orchestration loop runs outside the conversation context). Never runs a gated phase as a workflow. See modules/workflow-delegation.md.

max_agents.description: Concurrency cap for a delegated workflow run (runtime hard limit is 16 concurrent, 1000 total per run).

adversarial_debate.description: Competing-hypotheses debate among independent workers. See modules/adversarial-debate.md.

engine.description: auto resolves to subagents unless native Agent Teams is available AND agent_teams.prefer_when_available is true AND a split-pane mode exists.

phases.description: Phases where debate runs. validate is on by default; architect and debug are opt-in.

agent_teams.description: Native Claude Code Agent Teams. Recorded by capability detection but NOT used for the pipeline spine (breaks resumability, per-client isolation, per-agent skill routing). Only selected as the debate engine when prefer_when_available is true and the platform supports split panes.
